title: Kori Shinchu
body:
Syntax: perform kori shinchu <target>

Description: Mental damage that drains 20 Stamina and can disorient the target.  Also drains 20 Stamina on hit. Usable with any chakra nature. Base damage: 91-107. 65% chance to inflict disoriented. The effect lasts 20 seconds before resistance. Unlocks at level 32. Costs 31 Chakra and 0 Stamina; 5 second cooldown.

Date: 2026-09-27
